chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh and Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Rasūl Allāh صلى الله عليه وآله said: Allah has no need of one who has no share for Him in his wealth and his body.

key_terms.فِي مَالِهِ: in his wealth; from a person’s financial resources and possessions
key_terms.لَا حَاجَةَ: no need; indicating complete divine independence from the servant
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for Allah; referring to devotion and offering done purely for Him
key_terms.نَصِيبٌ: a share or portion assigned for Allah’s cause
key_terms.وَبَدَنِهِ: and his body; meaning physical effort, hardship, and bodily service in obedience

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says Allah has no need of a person who gives no share from his wealth and body?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a believer must devote both material resources and physical effort in the path of Allah. It emphasizes that faith is not merely a claim, but must be expressed through sacrifice, service, and obedience with one’s wealth and body.
